title: Kagamine Len — Prince Of The Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...!
Good. I have all the invitations I need for sharing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I bet Rin and the others are gonna be so surprised when they get invited to a show completely out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I took a bit of a break from doing shows to come up with new ideas and learn more about giving back to the fans...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But lately, the girls who made this place also just managed to get the ball rolling...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now that I'm done with my side dealings, I can get back to doing shows!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And since it's gonna be a special event, I really want Rin and the others there to see it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which is why I made these invitations...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, wait a minute... While I'm at it, I could throw in a little twist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Oh, there's Miku!
I'm glad that I made sure to look up her show schedule.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Is the side entrance to the stage over there? I need to be as quiet as possible so that I don't interrupt or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, leave the gift and invitation here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku and the crowd look like they're really having fun! I'd love to be up there with her, but I still need to deliver invitations to everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's a shame but I guess there's always next time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, MEIKO and Luka should be practicing somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Slowly... Make sure they don't notice you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Was that balloon always there...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the yellow one floating over there? It looks so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Look, MEIKO!
There's something tied to the end of its string!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Let's see... Invitations? For us? But it doesn't say who it's from...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Maybe it's not necessary.
This balloon is a nice hint♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess so...!
Now it makes sense!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. He really likes pulling little tricks like this, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure it all has to do with him wanting to spread hope and inspire everyone to see some wonderful dreams.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By doing this, the anticipation level for his show rises and makes it just that much more exciting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She should be practicing here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ow...
I feel again. During the same part too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, one more time!!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (That step sequence looks so tough, but she's not backing down from that challenge...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Uh oh... I hope she didn't twist her ankle just now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No! Why can't I do it?!
I thought I had it just now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness. She's okay.
But I still feel worried...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Maybe I should go and stop her instead of leaving this invitation behind...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna be a great idol just like Miku and the others. I wanna sparkle the way they do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to be able to help Minori and the girls more! I want to be there for them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, again!!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*... I...
I did it... I did it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is someone there...? I could've sworn that I heard somebody applauding just now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's something on top of my towel too. Lemme see... Oh, I'm being invited to see a show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Only one person I know would do something like this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin managed to figure it out all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They're all so dedicated and work so hard to be the best idols they can.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'm gonna put on a show that makes even them jump for joy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna give it everything I have!
